name: BUConsum_F
recordSource: SELECT Day([databc]) AS Ziua, Month([databc]) AS Luna, Year([databc]) AS Anul, Iesiri_H.NumarBC AS NrFact, Iesiri.Denumire, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS Cant, Iesiri.CodProdus, Iesiri.UM, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS SumOfCant, Round([PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]) AS Pret, Sum(Round([Iesiri]![cant]*[putva],[tempvars]![zec])) AS Valoare, Clienti.Denumire AS cDenumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Furnizori.Denumire AS Furnizor FROM (Masini INNER JOIN ((Clienti INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON Clienti.IDC = Iesiri_H.IDC) INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) ON Masini.IdMasina = Iesiri_H.IdMasina) INNER JOIN Furnizori ON Iesiri.IDF = Furnizori.IDF WHERE (((Iesiri_H.idbonconsum)=[forms]![bc]![IdBonConsum])) GROUP BY Day([databc]), Month([databc]), Year([databc]), Iesiri_H.NumarBC, Iesiri.Denumire, Iesiri.CodProdus, Iesiri.UM, Round([PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]), Clienti.Denumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Furnizori.Denumire;
